jobs.details: Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We're looking for native Arabic speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan. Why your language matters Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Arabic actually use their devices, so future products work better for them. What you'll do • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan. • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life. • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what's included. • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits. Who we're looking for • 18+ and currently living in NYC. • A native Arabic speaker who grew up in Saudi Arabia. • You use Arabic in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes. • You've used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years. • Comfortable communicating in English. • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon-Wed or Thu-Sat), starting October 16 on Friday. • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company. Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule. Compensation $1,200-1,600 for the full study. Simple and transparent Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what's involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like. How to apply Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We'll confirm your session dates once you're shortlisted. Apply now
